{{Top|leg}}
The '''Xi'Alpha''', commonly referred to as the '''Stictex''', was the most common [[Xi'Dec/Legends|Xi'Dec]] [[Gender/Legends|sex]]. Each Xi'Alpha had a cylindrical-shaped body, with a shiny carapace and a set of lacy wings that protruded from a slot in the center of the carapace. On their skulls, they had a set of pincers, twelve optic nerves on prehensile stalks, and six finger-length slots that acted as a nose.<ref name="GG4-1">''[[Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races]]''</ref> During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a family of seven Stictex traveled to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Prison/Legends|prison]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tol Ado]] and attended a tour of the facility.<ref name="JH">''[[Jedi's Honor]]''</ref>
